title: Innesto: overview film
description: 19 registry components as content elements. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 61 seconds: Innesto for TYPO3 v14. A marquee and live stats; Fifteen stats elements; Picked from the wizard; Every preset, light and dark. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: The shadcn and Magic UI registries publish hundreds of polished components, all written for React.
Innesto turns them into TYPO3 content elements, in your Desiderio theme.
The demo page shows a logo marquee and stats cards with sparklines, filled in by editors.
Fifteen stats elements ship as well: progress bars, status cards, usage breakdowns and charts.
Editors pick each element from the content wizard, with an icon and a backend preview.
The elements paint only with theme tokens, so every preset and dark mode just works.
With Innesto, one command turns a registry component into a content element.
